entities.name: DRD1
observations: Dopamine D1 receptor; co-expressed with CRHR2α in HEK293T cells and shown to co-immunoprecipitate with it.

entities.name: CRHR2α
observations: Corticotropin-releasing hormone receptor type-2α; co-expressed with DRD1 in HEK293T cells and shown to co-immunoprecipitate with it.

entities.name: PMID:32215915
observations: Primary 2020 study reported CRHR2α–DRD1 co-immunoprecipitation in HEK293T cells, dopamine-dependent CRHR2α surface reduction, and ERK1/2 signaling occlusion after co-activation.

entities.name: CRHR2α–DRD1 complex
observations: In co-expressing HEK293T cells, CRHR2α and DRD1 co-immunoprecipitated; receptor co-activation altered trafficking and reduced ERK1/2 signaling efficiency, supporting a functionally interacting complex.

entities.name: Native CRHR2α–DRD1 proximity
observations: In rat medial prefrontal-cortex synaptosomes, CRHR2α and DRD1 co-localized and simultaneous activation occluded ERK phosphorylation; this supports native co-presence and functional convergence but not definitive direct binding.
